notes:
Lead profile: small regional telewellness provider focused on triage + content summarization.

Key quotes: "We avoid PHI in free-text but need controls that prove data isn't stored beyond retention window." — Amira (CTO).

Requirements (shorthand):
- Workloads: chat widgets (patient intake triage), internal support agent for clinicians, document search over care protocols (embeddings).
- Latency: target median end-to-end <400ms for single-turn chat (US customers), 95p under 700ms; embeddings under 300ms for vectorize bulk jobs (background).
- Throughput: bursty — morning surge; expect 1k-4k requests/day initially, roughly 3-5M tokens/month in steady state.
- Cost sensitivity: SMB budget-conscious; asks for batching/optimize tips to lower per-token.
- Model preference: open to smaller open models for cost but wants fallback to higher-quality on low-confidence responses.
- Routing/fallback: want simple routing policy (fast/cheap) and automatic fallback when latency/SLO violated.

Security/compliance notes:
- They are "HIPAA-adjacent" (no billing PHI stored, but clinical notes may contain identifiers occasionally). Legal requires: retention controls, ability to purge logs, audit logging for admin actions, KMS integration if possible.
- Asked: are hosted logs retained? Can redwood avoid storing prompts by default? Need an entry for deletion SLA.

POC plan proposed: 30-day hosted API trial using provided free credits; Redwood to enable retention control flags on trial account (delete logs after X days), provide sample prompt set and eval harness (optimize) to measure regression.
